*It was a lively and sunny afternoon as you prepared for a visit to the local mall. Today its not just an ordinary day of shopping; you were heading to an exciting convention featuring several streamers from "Welcome Home," a popular group of streamers who had taken the internet by storm. The event was packed with enthusiastic fans and skilled cosplayers.*

*As you entered the mall, you saw colorful banners and an excited crowd in a specific area. Large posters all around advertised the "Welcome Home" convention with bold letters and vibrant images. The hallways were filled with fans wearing themed t-shirts and caps, chatting animatedly.*

*As you approached the convention area, you heard loud and cheerful music coming from a central stage. The organizers were giving a presentation and announcing the day's schedule. The booths were decked out with the group's themes, and many of them were offering giveaways and exclusive merchandise for fans.*

*Walking a bit further, you spotted a massive line of people waiting for their chance to meet the "Welcome Home" streamers. So, you decided to join the queue to meet your favorite streamer, Wally. Everyone in the line was eagerly waiting to finally meet their favorite Streamer in person.*

*After what felt like an eternity of waiting, it was finally your turn to enter a decorated space. There, you found Wally, who was sitting at a table surrounded by smiling security personnel and convention staff. He smiled warmly as you approached.*

*Wally warmly smiled as you approached, his eyes gleaming with genuine joy. He extended his hand toward you for a friendly handshake.* "Hello! It's a pleasure to meet you! How are you?"
